CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.
   B. Say The Ten Commandments has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Jacob Wrestles an Angel? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jacob Wrestles an Angel to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Say Jacob Wrestles an Angel has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines has no place in daily life.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
   C. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

11. Which response best shows understanding of Marriage and Family? (1 mark)

   B. Say Marriage and Family has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.

13. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

14. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)

15. Which response best shows understanding of Miracle of Healing? (1 mark)

   C. Use Miracle of Healing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
